reasoning_summary: The fix involves changing the logic for how type arguments are retrieved and compared (using unrollVariableAssignments) and modifying the termination condition for the recursive type argument search. This is a procedural correction to the algorithm used to traverse and resolve type hierarchies, rather than a simple missing check or a wrong constant assignment.
evidence_used: The fix modifies the loop logic in TypeUtils to use unrollVariableAssignments instead of direct map access.
The fix modifies the termination condition in the recursive search (if (toClass.equals(cls))) to correctly handle class hierarchy traversal.
The bug report states that the current code ignores classes that specify their own type variables, which is a procedural error in the type resolution algorithm.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix involves a conditional change, the core issue is the incorrect implementation of the type resolution algorithm, not just a missing guard.
The fix is a local procedural correction within existing methods, not a design-level capability addition.
